nodes.name: Init Pagination
nodes.notes: Initialize page=1, limit=100, hasMore=true. Number types are critical.

nodes.name: GHL Search Opportunities
nodes.notes: CRITICAL: Body Content Type = Raw/Custom, MIME = application/json, Body uses expression wrapper. See docs/FIX_EXPLANATION.md.

parameters.query:
MERGE INTO RAW.GHL_OPPORTUNITIES AS target
USING (
  SELECT
    $1:OPPORTUNITY_ID::STRING AS OPPORTUNITY_ID,
    $1:LOCATION_ID::STRING AS LOCATION_ID,
    $1:CONTACT_ID::STRING AS CONTACT_ID,
    $1:CONTACT_NAME::STRING AS CONTACT_NAME,
    $1:CONTACT_EMAIL::STRING AS CONTACT_EMAIL,
    $1:CONTACT_PHONE::STRING AS CONTACT_PHONE,
    $1:PIPELINE_ID::STRING AS PIPELINE_ID,
    $1:PIPELINE_STAGE_ID::STRING AS PIPELINE_STAGE_ID,
    $1:PIPELINE_NAME::STRING AS PIPELINE_NAME,
    $1:STAGE_NAME::STRING AS STAGE_NAME,
    $1:STATUS::STRING AS STATUS,
    $1:MONETARY_VALUE::NUMBER(12,2) AS MONETARY_VALUE,
    $1:SOURCE::STRING AS SOURCE,
    $1:ASSIGNED_TO::STRING AS ASSIGNED_TO,
    $1:CREATED_AT::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS CREATED_AT,
    $1:UPDATED_AT::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS UPDATED_AT,
    $1:LAST_STATUS_CHANGE_AT::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS LAST_STATUS_CHANGE_AT,
    $1:LAST_STAGE_CHANGE_AT::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS LAST_STAGE_CHANGE_AT,
    $1:NAME::STRING AS NAME,
    $1:_LOADED_AT::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS _LOADED_AT
  FROM VALUES (PARSE_JSON('{{ $json.toJsonString() }}'))
) AS source
ON target.OPPORTUNITY_ID = source.OPPORTUNITY_ID
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
  target.LOCATION_ID = source.LOCATION_ID,
  target.CONTACT_ID = source.CONTACT_ID,
  target.CONTACT_NAME = source.CONTACT_NAME,
  target.CONTACT_EMAIL = source.CONTACT_EMAIL,
  target.CONTACT_PHONE = source.CONTACT_PHONE,
  target.PIPELINE_ID = source.PIPELINE_ID,
  target.PIPELINE_STAGE_ID = source.PIPELINE_STAGE_ID,
  target.PIPELINE_NAME = source.PIPELINE_NAME,
  target.STAGE_NAME = source.STAGE_NAME,
  target.STATUS = source.STATUS,
  target.MONETARY_VALUE = source.MONETARY_VALUE,
  target.SOURCE = source.SOURCE,
  target.ASSIGNED_TO = source.ASSIGNED_TO,
  target.CREATED_AT = source.CREATED_AT,
  target.UPDATED_AT = source.UPDATED_AT,
  target.LAST_STATUS_CHANGE_AT = source.LAST_STATUS_CHANGE_AT,
  target.LAST_STAGE_CHANGE_AT = source.LAST_STAGE_CHANGE_AT,
  target.NAME = source.NAME,
  target._LOADED_AT = source._LOADED_AT
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (
  OPPORTUNITY_ID, LOCATION_ID, CONTACT_ID, CONTACT_NAME, CONTACT_EMAIL,
  CONTACT_PHONE, PIPELINE_ID, PIPELINE_STAGE_ID, PIPELINE_NAME, STAGE_NAME,
  STATUS, MONETARY_VALUE, SOURCE, ASSIGNED_TO, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT,
  LAST_STATUS_CHANGE_AT, LAST_STAGE_CHANGE_AT, NAME, _LOADED_AT
) VALUES (
  source.OPPORTUNITY_ID, source.LOCATION_ID, source.CONTACT_ID, source.CONTACT_NAME,
  source.CONTACT_EMAIL, source.CONTACT_PHONE, source.PIPELINE_ID,
  source.PIPELINE_STAGE_ID, source.PIPELINE_NAME, source.STAGE_NAME,
  source.STATUS, source.MONETARY_VALUE, source.SOURCE, source.ASSIGNED_TO,
  source.CREATED_AT, source.UPDATED_AT, source.LAST_STATUS_CHANGE_AT,
  source.LAST_STAGE_CHANGE_AT, source.NAME, source._LOADED_AT
);

nodes.name: Increment Page
nodes.notes: Increment page. Compute hasMore from meta.total vs currentPage * limit.

nodes.name: More Pages?
nodes.notes: Continue if hasMore=true AND last response had >= 1 opportunity.
